review.note: Planting months from the CONAB state planting calendar; soybean dates follow the MAPA/ADAPAR sanitary-break regulation. Awaiting review by a Paraná agronomist (IDR-Paraná / EMBRAPA).

sources.title: CONAB - Calendário de plantio e colheita de grãos no Brasil (Paraná rows)
IBGE - Localidades API (municipalities of Paraná and their mesoregions)
ADAPAR - Períodos do vazio sanitário da soja, safra 2026/2027 (MAPA Portaria nº 1.579/2026)

groundwater.note: No state groundwater stress category is published in the same form as India's CGWB assessment.

crops.note: Statewide fallback 20 Sep-31 Dec; each municipality carries its own legal window (see districts).
Black oat is also the main winter cover crop for no-till.
